scope: Actual production Compile over the 16 original ROLE_CASES Briefs and caller-supplied synthetic cards. Cards are supplied evidence, not fresh media observations. Compilation alone is not a role-semantics or prose-quality verdict.

issues.message: Keep copied BGM distinct from property-only voice, music-style, beat or texture references. Property-only references cannot play the original recording; copied BGM must not be described as never copying its signal. N/A music can mean no added score while the supplied BGM is copied.
Bind actions and pronouns to the correct typed target subject; an environment or style definition cannot act as the requested person or vehicle.
